questions.question: What is a computer? Give one example.
questions.reference_answer: A computer is an electronic device that accepts data as input, processes the data, and produces useful information as output. A desktop computer is an example.
expected_concepts: A computer is an electronic device
It accepts data as input
It processes the input data
It produces useful information as output
A valid example of a computer is given

rubric.criterion: Identifies a computer as an electronic device
Explains that a computer accepts or takes data as input
Explains that a computer processes the data
Explains that the computer produces information or output
Provides a valid example of a computer

questions.question: What is RAM?
questions.reference_answer: RAM (Random Access Memory) is temporary memory used to store data and programs that are currently being used by the computer. It is volatile memory, so its contents are lost when the computer is switched off.
expected_concepts: RAM is a type of computer memory
It temporarily stores data
It stores data or programs currently being used
RAM is volatile memory
Its contents are lost when the computer is switched off

rubric.criterion: Identifies RAM as computer memory
Explains that RAM temporarily stores data
Explains that RAM is used by currently running or active programs
Explains that RAM loses its stored information when power is switched off

questions.question: What is an operating system? Give one example.
questions.reference_answer: An operating system is system software that manages computer hardware and software and allows the user to interact with the computer. Windows is an example.
expected_concepts: An operating system is software
It helps the user interact with or use the computer
It manages computer hardware
It allows or manages programs to run
Windows is a valid example

rubric.criterion: Identifies an operating system as software
Explains that it helps the user interact with or use the computer
Explains that it manages computer hardware
Explains that it allows or manages programs to run
Provides a valid example such as Windows

questions.question: What is the purpose of a keyboard?
questions.reference_answer: A keyboard is an input device used to enter text, numbers, and commands into a computer.
expected_concepts: A keyboard is an input device
It is used to enter information into a computer
It can be used to enter text
It can be used to enter numbers or commands

rubric.criterion: Correctly identifies a keyboard as an input device
Explains that a keyboard is used to enter information into a computer
Mentions a valid type of input such as text, numbers, or commands

questions.question: What is a web browser? Give one example.
questions.reference_answer: A web browser is software used to access and view websites on the internet. Google Chrome is an example.
expected_concepts: A web browser is software or an application
It is used to open or access websites
It is used on the internet or web
Google Chrome is a valid example

rubric.criterion: Identifies a web browser as software or an application
Explains that it is used to access or open websites
Connects its use with the internet or web
Provides a valid example such as Google Chrome
